name: rent.carol/car-rental
title: CAROL RENT rental quotes
description: Read-only quotes for car rental, with a pre-filled booking link; it cannot book or charge.

tools.name: quote_rental
tools.description: Calculate the price of a car rental from an explicit configuration: pickup place, exact pickup and return moments with offsets, timezone, and car group. A calculation only, not a reservation: no car is held or guaranteed and availability is NOT checked. The figure is an estimate for the chosen car group (a category, not a specific vehicle) and is not a comparison of what is available. Conditions you omit take stated defaults, listed under "assumptions".

location.description: Pickup place: exactly one of areaSlug (a Carol place, e.g. "kyiv") or custom (coordinates).

pickup.description: Exact pickup moment with a required offset, to the minute: 2026-12-03T12:00:00+02:00 or 2026-12-03T10:00:00Z. Must be in the future and within 12 months (judged by dates in timeZone).

return.description: Exact return moment, same format, after the pickup.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone used only to show local times, to judge "today" and the 12-month limit, and to label the link. It is not checked against the pickup place and does not change the price: the pickup and return instants above are what is priced. Use the pickup place's zone.

car.description: Car group (a category, not a specific vehicle).

payment.description: Payment method at pickup. Optional; default "any".

receiving.description: How the car is handed over. Optional; default "any".

dailyMileageKm.description: Daily mileage in km; 900 is unlimited. Optional; default 150.

depositUsd.description: Security deposit in USD. Optional; default 1000.

driverAge.description: Driver age bracket: 25 means 25+. Optional; default 25.

tools.name: get_rental_completion_link
tools.description: Return a link to Carol's booking wizard with this exact rental pre-filled, for the renter to open, review and complete themselves. The link holds no personal data and no price; the price is calculated again when it is opened and is not locked. Calculation only, not a reservation: availability is not checked. Nothing is booked or paid by this tool, and there is no tool that does. Includes a fresh calculation when one is available.
